```{r setup}
#| include: false
source(here::here("R", "site_helpers.R"))
NAME <- "@@NAME@@"; TIER <- "@@TIER@@"; LAS <- @@LAS@@; PARENT <- "@@PARENT@@"; V1_DOC <- "@@V1DOC@@"
V <- load_va()
W <- va_wide(V)
LADS <- readRDS(here::here("data", "sussex_lads.rds"))
in_area <- if (TIER == "district") W$lad %in% NAME else W$LANAME %in% LAS
w <- W[in_area, ] |> arrange(desc(va_shrunk_all))
lads <- if (TIER == "district") LADS[LADS$lad == NAME, ] else LADS[LADS$la %in% LAS, ]
n <- nrow(w)
m <- function(g) mean(w[[paste0("va_shrunk_", g)]], na.rm = TRUE)
above <- sum(w$va_lo_all > 0, na.rm = TRUE); below <- sum(w$va_hi_all < 0, na.rm = TRUE)
la_at <- function(la, g) V$la |> filter(LANAME == la, group == g)
yrs <- V$spec$years
sh <- function(x, d = 1) sprintf(paste0("%+.", d, "f"), x)
schools_txt <- function(k) if (k == 1) "1 school" else paste(k, "schools")
n_sig <- function(k, dir) if (k == 0) paste("none", dir) else paste(k, dir)
OFSTED_KIND <- c("Report card" = "report card", "No overall grade" = "inspection with no overall grade",
                 "Graded" = "graded inspection", "Ungraded only" = "ungraded visit only")
ofsted_txt_area <- function(k) { t <- table(factor(k, names(OFSTED_KIND))); t <- t[t > 0]
  and_list(sprintf("%d %s%s", as.vector(t), OFSTED_KIND[names(t)], ifelse(as.vector(t) == 1 | names(t) == "Ungraded only", "", "s"))) }
lc1 <- function(x) sub("^(.)", "\\L\\1", x, perl = TRUE)
v1d <- w$va_nat_all - w$v1_all
orig <- function(text) sprintf("[%s](%s/%s)", text, ORIGINAL_SITE, V1_DOC)
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
## About this page

Value Added v2.0 for `r NAME`'s state-funded secondary schools, `r yl(min(yrs))`
to `r yl(max(yrs))`, measured against England: see [the method](@@ROOT@@method.qmd).
The original analysis, with absence, suspensions and trusts in depth, is
`r orig("here")`. Built from published DfE and Ofsted data; nothing uses
pupil-level records.
:::

# Summary {.unnumbered}

```{r summary}
#| results: asis
b <- c(
  sprintf("**%s with value added for all pupils averaging %s points** against England: %s significantly above expectation and %s.",
          schools_txt(n), sh(m("all")), n_sig(above, "significantly above"), n_sig(below, "below")) |>
    sub(pattern = "and none below\\.$", replacement = "and none below."),
  sprintf("**Disadvantaged pupils: %s points; non-disadvantaged pupils: %s.**", sh(m("disadvantaged")), sh(m("non_disadvantaged"))),
  sprintf("**Girls: %s points; boys: %s.**", sh(m("girls")), sh(m("boys"))),
  if (n) sprintf("**Strongest: %s (%s). Weakest: %s (%s).**", w$SCHNAME[1], sh(w$va_shrunk_all[1]),
                 w$SCHNAME[n], sh(w$va_shrunk_all[n])),
  if (TIER == "la") {
    e <- la_at(NAME, "all"); ed <- la_at(NAME, "disadvantaged")
    sprintf("**The authority's own effect is %s (%s of %d)%s for all pupils, and %s (%s) for disadvantaged pupils.** Value added against England includes it.",
            sprintf("%+.1f%%", pct(e$effect)), ord(e$rank), e$n_la, ifelse(e$sig, ", distinguishable from zero", ""),
            sprintf("%+.1f%%", pct(ed$effect)), ord(ed$rank))
  },
  if (any(!is.na(w$v1_all)))
    sprintf("**Against the published v1 measure**, the area's schools move by %s points on average (v2 against England minus v1 within the authority).",
            sh(mean(v1d, na.rm = TRUE))),
  sprintf("**Latest Ofsted:** %s.", ofsted_txt_area(w$ofsted_kind))
)
cat(paste0("- ", b[!is.na(b) & nzchar(b)], collapse = "\n"), "\n")
```

```{r tbl-schools}

w |>
  transmute(School = SCHNAME, District = lad,
            `All pupils` = va_txt(va_shrunk_all, va_lo_all, va_hi_all),
            Disadv. = sh(va_shrunk_disadvantaged), `Non-disadv.` = sh(va_shrunk_non_disadvantaged),
            Girls = ifelse(is.na(va_shrunk_girls), "", sh(va_shrunk_girls)),
            Boys = ifelse(is.na(va_shrunk_boys), "", sh(va_shrunk_boys)),
            `v1` = ifelse(is.na(v1_all), "", sh(v1_all)),
            `Ofsted latest` = coalesce(ofsted_latest, ""),
            `Run by (2024/25)` = coalesce(run_by, "")) |>
  select(where(~any(nzchar(as.character(.x)) & !is.na(.x)))) |>
```

# What explains the area's results

```{r decomp}
#| include: false
areas <- if (TIER == "region") c(NAME, LAS) else if (TIER == "district") c(NAME, PARENT) else NAME
dec <- bind_rows(lapply(areas, function(a) {
  u <- if (a == NAME) w$URN else if (a %in% LAS || a == PARENT) W$URN[W$LANAME == a] else integer()
  decompose(V, u, a)
})) |> mutate(area = factor(area, areas))
d_get <- function(a, g, comp) dec$points[dec$area == a & dec$group == g & dec$component == comp]
top2 <- function(a, g) dec |> filter(area == a, group == g, component != "Unexplained (school)") |>
  arrange(desc(abs(points))) |> slice(1:2) |> mutate(t = sprintf("%s (%+.1f)", lc1(component), points)) |> pull(t)
```

```{r fig-decomp}
#| fig-cap: "Why average Attainment 8 differs from England's, by factor, all school-years, on the v2.0 model. Approximate Attainment 8 points; the pieces sum to each panel's gap. 'Unexplained (school)' is the schools' own residual, before shrinkage and net of the authority and region effects, so it differs from the value added above."
#| fig-height: !expr 1.2 + 3.6 * length(areas)
fig_decomp(dec)
```

For all pupils, `r NAME`'s two largest pieces are `r and_list(top2(NAME, "All pupils"))`,
and its schools themselves account for `r sh(d_get(NAME, "All pupils", "Unexplained (school)"))`
points. For disadvantaged pupils the two largest are
`r and_list(top2(NAME, "Disadvantaged"))`, and the schools
`r sh(d_get(NAME, "Disadvantaged", "Unexplained (school)"))`.

```{r districts}
  w |> group_by(District = lad) |>
    summarise(Schools = n(), `All pupils` = sh(mean(va_shrunk_all, na.rm = TRUE)),
              Disadvantaged = sh(mean(va_shrunk_disadvantaged, na.rm = TRUE)),
              Girls = sh(mean(va_shrunk_girls, na.rm = TRUE)), Boys = sh(mean(va_shrunk_boys, na.rm = TRUE)),
              `Above / below` = paste(sum(va_lo_all > 0, na.rm = TRUE), "/", sum(va_hi_all < 0, na.rm = TRUE)),
              .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(District = ifelse(District == "Brighton and Hove", District,
                             sprintf('<a href="@@ROOT@@areas/%s.html">%s</a>', slug(District), District))) |>
    kt(align = "lrrrrrr", escape = FALSE)
}
```

# Notes on method {.unnumbered}

Value added v2.0 is described on [the method page](@@ROOT@@method.qmd).
School districts come from each school's postcode. The decomposition
splits each area's mean log Attainment 8 against England's into one piece
per model term, exactly, and converts to points at England's mean. This
page is generated from `templates/area.qmd` by `R/03_area_pages.R`.
